analysis: pre- 表示“在前、优先”，vail- 来自拉丁语 valere（强壮、有力）。
字面义为“力量占先”，引申为“盛行、获胜”。

meanings.meaning_en: to prove more powerful than opposing forces and succeed
examples: Justice will prevail in the end.

meanings.meaning_en: to be widespread or generally accepted at a particular time
examples: A sense of optimism prevailed among the team.
